user.title: Provident MeterConnex usage portal
user.description: Use your usage portal credentials at provident.meterconnex.com, not your providentbilling.com billing login. For most active customers, the username is the LOC-ID on the bill and the password is the 6-digit Customer Number.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach or read MeterConnex usage data.
error.no_meters: No meters were found for this usage account.
error.no_supported_meters: No supported electricity, water, heating, or cooling meters were found.

abort.already_configured: This usage account is already configured.
